sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to face Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. This is a strong fixture for the league leaders on paper, as Alsager sit bottom with just 4 points and arrive in poor form with only one win in their last five. Sandbach come into the match on the back of a recent loss but maintain an otherwise solid record of seven wins and one draw from their ten outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) host bottom-half Dawley Town at 15:00, offering an opportunity to close the gap on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, are at home to Eccleshall (6th, 18 points) in a direct mid-table clash. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points in fourth, visit Wednesfield Community (9th, 13 points) in their Saturday fixture before a midweek cup replay against Brereton Social. Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) host struggling Foley Meir (13th, 11 points) at 15:00. Barnton (7th, 15 points) welcome Shawbury United (15th, 10 points), while New Mills (8th, 14 points) travel to face Market Drayton Town (10th, 12 points). In the basement battle, Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th, 7 points) visit Telford Town (18th, 6 points) at 15:00, and Crewe host Allscott Heath (11th, 11 points) in another lower-table fixture. Brereton Social (14th, 11 points) are at home to Widnes Town (20th, 2 points) in Saturday's only clear mismatch. The midweek fixture sees Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community on Wednesday evening at 19:45.
